mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_order (customer_idx, product_type, sample_code, quantity, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_addr, memo, status) VALUES (#{customerIdx}, #{productType}, #{sampleCode}, #{quantity}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingAddr}, #{memo}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT idx, customer_idx, product_type, sample_code, quantity, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_addr, memo, status, c_date, u_date FROM product_order WHERE customer_idx = #{customerIdx} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY idx DESC
